The '''Line Branch''' was a division of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] tasked with handling strategy, tactics and administration. It was responsible for the warships, capital ships and support ships, including all the commanders and crews of those ships.<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> Its three largest divisions were the [[Deck Division|Deck]], [[Logistics Division/Legends|Logistics]], and [[Administration Division]]s.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Nemet/Legends|Nemet]] served as a member of this branch in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Nemet">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Commander Nemet}}</ref>
